entries.text: Brrrrrr... I’m freezing.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_first_00

entries.text: The AC’s way too strong in here...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_first_01

entries.text: So, you’re the one who called me, huh?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_00

entries.text: You DO know this is gonna be a major downer\nfor the school, right?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_01

entries.text: I can’t imagine how having me around is going to\nbenefit anybody here...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_02

entries.text: That’s not true!
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_select_01

entries.text: You think...?
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_select_02

entries.text: ...You’re awfully sure about this. Where does that\nconfidence come from?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_03

entries.text: Hmph, I figured... You’re not sure about this\neither, are you?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_03b

entries.text: Well, I’m here anyway. I’m going to do my job.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_04

entries.text: I am a professional, believe it or not...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_05

entries.text: You, huh...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_00

entries.text: Have you been to the Polar Biome in the\nTerarium? That place is pretty impressive.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_01

entries.text: The snow’s so soft and powdery... I can’t believe\nit’s artificial.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_02

entries.text: Plenty of straight slopes, and lots of curves too.\nIt’s perfect for snowboarding.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_03

entries.text: You’re gonna board?!
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_select_01

entries.text: Let’s hit the slopes!
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_select_02

entries.text: Oh, no, I didn’t mean it like that...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_04

entries.text: I can’t help but check out the slopes when I see\nsnowy mountains. Old habits die hard.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_05

entries.text: This academy’s something else though, eh?\nBuilding a mountain like that on school grounds...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_06

entries.text: I just came back from climbing that big mountain\nin the Polar Biome.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_00

entries.text: Cetoddle and the rest were all hyped to be on a\nmountain other than Glaseado.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_01

entries.text: I guess it rubbed off on me. I just couldn’t resist\nand, well...I had a few runs on my board.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_02

entries.text: Niiice!
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_select_03

entries.text: How’d it go?
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_select_04

entries.text: Oh, the snow was good. Yeah... Real good.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_03

entries.text: I hadn’t boarded in a long time, so I think I got\na bit too fired up.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_04

entries.text: You know, I’d made up my mind that I wouldn’t\nsnowboard anymore...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_05

entries.text: but maybe I can from time to time—just when\nI’m here.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_06

entries.text: ...Yeah, yeah, I’m weak-willed. Sorry.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_00

entries.text: But if I’m gonna be uncool, I might as well lean\ninto it. I’ve got another tiresome idea.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_01

entries.text: What do you say we trade Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_02

entries.text: Oh, you seriously want to? Well, OK.\c\nI’ll be trading a Cetoddle. What’ll you pick?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_03

entries.text: A [VAR 0x0101(0001)]... Yeah... That’s not bad.\c\nIt’d be way uncool if I raised your Pokémon\npoorly. I’ll make sure to take good care of it.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]All right. My Cetoddle for your\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)],\r\nthen?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Grusha a Pokémon if you aren’t\nits original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Grusha such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Grusha a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_02_03

entries.text:
Wait... Are you trying to trade away the only
Pokémon in your party? That’s real uncool...\c
Come back when you have at least two Pokémon
with you.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_03_00

entries.text: ...I was just kidding anyway. Don’t worry about it.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_03_01

entries.text: In the mood for something uncool? How about\na Pokémon trade?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_04_00

entries.text: What’s that look for? Do you want to battle me\nor something?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_talkto_00

entries.text: Yep. That’s the right decision.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_cancel_00

entries.text: Ugh, so uncool... But I guess dealing with stuff\nlike this from time to time isn’t too bad.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 59]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: Oof... That’s what I call a sound defeat. The icy\nbite of reality is harsh as always...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: But I had fun. I think I learned a little something,\ntoo.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: To the victor go the spoils. Here, you can have\nthese.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: Just throw them away if you don’t need them.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 59]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00

entries.text: You really do seem to enjoy defeating me.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: Well, next time the result will be much cooler...\nfor me and my team![VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: Listen, going easy on me’s not gonna make me\nhappy, even if I do get to win.\c\nGo all out next time, OK?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: I’m not great with students... I just imagine how\nthey might have to give up on their dreams in the\r\nfuture, and...it makes me feel so bad for ’em.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
Seems like some people have heard of me all the
way over here.\c
They keep asking me for photos... Taking one
with you was enough for me, though.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
The AC is way too strong in here. Aren’t you
cold, too?\c
Who do I need to bother to get the heat
turned up?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)]’s doing pretty good. Gets
along
fine
with
my
other
Pokémon.\c
It’s real chill. I like it.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_03

entries.text: How’s that Cetoddle I traded you?\c\nHe has a tendency to wander off, so keep an eye\non him during picnics and stuff.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_04

entries.text:
By the way... Geeta mentioned that you said I
was your favorite Gym Leader.\c
I don’t know how you came to that conclusion...
It’s so uncool, seriously.\c
But, well...I appreciate the thought. So, uh...
Thanks, I guess.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
